name: suom1saundi
author: g0rst
description: A six-voice groovebox for suomisaundi (Finnish freestyle psytrance): psy kick, acid bass, hats with an 8-bit noise channel, a 303-style acid line, a sound-chip lead with arpeggios and an FM zap voice, on a polymetric step sequencer with chance, slides, SEKO (the pattern played a little differently each time) and a groove generator; an 8-bit crusher per track, tempo delay, reverb and kick ducking.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp (MPL-2.0); sequencer and UI from ro:MINImal; 8-bit ideas from memetek-fm1; acid ideas from neur0psy.
